pr_body:
* Retake lock when using a dependent transaction from a TransactionScope ([#76010](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/76010)).
* Reset TransactionTransmitter and Receiver before reusing them ([#76010](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/76010)).
* Increase MSDTC startup timeout from 2.5 to 30 seconds ([#75822](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/75822))

Fixes #76010
Fixes #75822

review_comments: Unless there's higher-level synchronization I don't see, races could result in going above the maximum.  Is that ok?

Yeah, it should be fine. As above, all this is is a best-effort caching mechanism to recycle ITransactionReceivers/ITransactionTransmitters. If there end up being over-maximum instances in the queue, that's fine.
Ok, cool.  Might be worth a comment for a future reader that the max limit is soft.
Oops, didn't notice this before clicking merge. Will add a comment in #76376.
